catalog_description: Generated PDF letters of the offer terms, versioned alongside the structured offer and linked to the e-signature envelope.
Reusable offer-letter templates with merge tokens for candidate, role, and pay terms, versioned by jurisdiction and language to render offer letters.
Versioned snapshots of a job offer during negotiation, each holding the structured terms and the author of the change, from initial through accepted.
Periodic status updates on an objective or key result during the active cycle, the cadence of record for OKR programs.
Measurable results attached to an objective, the unit of scoring that tracks progress toward the goal.
Goals with measurable key results, owner accountability, and weighted progress rollup, organized in a hierarchy and reviewed on a quarterly or annual cadence.
Groups of new hires onboarding together, such as a campus class or training batch, enabling shared activities and cohort-level reporting.
Paperwork collected from a new hire during onboarding, such as tax and eligibility forms, with signature state and e-signature envelope references.
Live onboarding journeys for a specific new hire, carrying assigned tasks, current stage, completion state, and milestone timestamps.
Reusable templates defining the stages, tasks, timing, and assignees for onboarding a class of new hire, versioned and selected by role, location, or type.
Phases within an onboarding plan or journey, such as pre-boarding or 30/60/90 day, defining task grouping, duration, and gate conditions.
Discrete to-do items within an onboarding journey, each with an assignee, due date, type, and completion state, some triggering handoffs to other systems.
Formal models of concepts, properties, relationships, and rules that define the schema tier of a knowledge graph, including namespaces and constraint shapes.
Operating-cadence meeting records (quarterly, monthly, weekly) with agenda, participants, commentary, and action items, locked as an audit trail once closed.
Deployments of cluster operators and controllers, such as certificate management, monitoring, and GitOps lifecycle controllers.
Employee expressions of interest in an internal opportunity, tracking status from submitted through accepted, rejected, or withdrawn.
Equity pools reserved for employee grants, tracking pool size, available headroom, reservation workflows, and board-approved expansions.
Reusable multichannel plays defining the triggers, audience, channel sequence, and exit criteria for an automated campaign.
Inventory allocation decisions per order line across warehouses, stores, and fulfillment partners, tracking allocated, partial, or backorder state.
Individual product lines within an order, with quantity, price, discount, and tax breakdown.
Proposed organization structure changes such as new or eliminated positions and reporting-line shifts, capturing current versus proposed state and the migration path.
Nodes in the organizational hierarchy such as divisions, departments, and teams, with manager, cost center alignment, geographic scope, and parent-child links.
OSHA Form 300 logs of work-related injuries and illnesses, maintained per establishment per year, with the annual 300A summary.
OSHA Form 301 injury and illness incident reports, filed per recordable incident.
Unplanned losses of service affecting customer connections, with detection time, cause, estimated restoration, and affected customer count.
Ordered steps within an outreach sequence, each defining the channel, day offset, message template, and whether the step is automated or needs a recruiter action.
Named multi-step sourcing cadences that automate candidate outreach across channels, holding the sequence name, owner, channel mix, and active status.
Engagements with external law firms, covering firm, attorney, matter, scope, billing arrangement, budget, and status to track spend and coordination.
Backing services attached to an app, such as databases, queues, caches, and logging, with type, plan, provisioning status, and cost.
Core application records on the platform, with name, region, runtime, git repository, environment variables, and domain bindings.
Build artifacts captured during continuous integration, with buildpack output, slug size, build time, version, and environment changes.
Release records that activate a build, with app reference, version, status, timestamp, and the person who deployed it.
Deployment environments such as dev, staging, and production, with environment-specific config overrides, resource limits, and addon bindings.
Running compute units (process containers) for an app, with type, size, uptime, memory and CPU metrics, and status.
Assignments of a herd to a paddock for a grazing period, with start and end dates, stocking rate, and expected versus actual rest.
Scheduled or ad-hoc deployments of OS and software patches to a set of endpoints, with per-endpoint approval, execution status, and rollback state.
Scheduled visits between patient and provider, with location, time, visit type, reason, and status from scheduled through completed or no-show.
Provider-initiated requests for specialist consultation or external service, with clinical indication, urgency, insurance authorization, and status.
Payroll cycle executions scoped to a pay group, country, and period, driving gross-to-net calculation and producing pay slips, journal entries, and tax filings.
Per-employee per-cycle gross-to-net pay statements, showing earnings, deductions, contributions, withholdings, net pay, and year-to-date totals.
Scheduled batches of supplier payments grouped by bank account, currency, and method, driving the accounts-payable payment cycle.
Payment attempts and authorizations on an order (charge, decline, refund, capture) tracked through a multi-state lifecycle.
General-ledger postings produced by a pay run, broken down into debit and credit lines by cost center, department, and pay code.
Partner capital account statements per investor per close period, showing contributions, distributions, gains, fees, and ending balance, locked once distributed.
Security-awareness training records for staff who handle card data, kept for PCI DSS compliance.
Calculated workforce metrics such as time-to-fill, attrition, retention, and cost-per-hire, derived from HR, recruiting, learning, and payroll event streams.
Individual performance goals with owner, period, metric, weight, and status, aligned to organizational objectives and reviewed within performance cycles.
Per-cycle per-worker review records holding self and manager assessments, ratings, narrative, and calibration outcome.
Citizen or business submissions requesting a license or permit, with applicant, permit type, fees due, supporting documents, and review status.
Field inspections tied to a permit, with type, scheduled date, inspector, location, outcome, and required corrections or follow-up.
Buyer or user personas describing role, goals, pains, and buying triggers, referenced by messaging and content.
Context-aware branching rules that show a tailored variant to a given audience segment within an experience.
Owner and client records for a veterinary practice, with contact details, payment method on file, communication preferences, and account balance history.
Per-recipient outcomes of a phishing simulation, recording whether each person clicked, reported, or ignored the test message.
Configured simulated-phishing campaigns used for security-awareness training and PCI DSS compliance.
Business or technical goals a team commits to for a program increment, scored on planned versus actual business value at the review.
Pickup sites such as host locations, depots, or on-farm points, with operating hours and self-serve member capacity.
Definitions of product attributes available to products, with data type, validation rules, attribute group, locale awareness, and channel overrides.
Hierarchical taxonomy nodes used to classify products, supporting multiple parallel category trees through a parent self-reference.
Image, video, 3D model, and document assets tied to products, with rights metadata, renditions, and delivery URLs.
Merchandising master records for sellable products, hubs of attributes, descriptions, variants, categories, translations, and assets consumed across channels.
Definitions of outbound publishing channels such as marketplaces and merchant feeds, holding destination mappings, credentials, and per-channel overrides.
Publish runs that send a product or batch to a syndication channel, with queue position, status, validation results, and rejection reasons.
Locale-keyed translations of a product attribute or description, driving multi-language publishing through machine, human, or hybrid pipelines.
Specific size, color, or pack-size variants of a parent product, each with its own SKU and publish state, inheriting attribute defaults from the parent.
Execution instances of a data pipeline, with runtime status, lineage snapshot, and error state.
Sales-process stage definitions with exit criteria, default probability, and allowed transitions, the configuration behind the opportunity pipeline.
Append-only records of plan approvals, locks, and the downstream push events they trigger.
Saved snapshots of a plan at a point in time, kept for comparison and audit.
Shelf-layout and product-placement compliance checks against corporate planogram standards, with deviations, remediation, and photo evidence.
Per-pass planting events, recording seed variety, rate, depth, date, and weather conditions.
Continuous-delivery pipelines wired into the cluster, covering GitOps, fleet orchestration, and in-cluster build and deploy.
Resolved product configurations, each a validated combination of option selections that is sellable or buildable, with its own price, lead time, and bill of materials.
Preventive maintenance work orders covering scope, schedule, assignee, and execution status for planned upkeep.
Records that a user read and acknowledged a policy, with timestamp, policy version, medium, and completion evidence.
Individual coverage lines within an insurance policy, with line of business, limit, deductible, coinsurance, and effective period that govern claim eligibility.
ESG and diversity metric submissions per portfolio company per period, supporting regulatory and investor ESG reporting.
KPI submission cycles per portfolio company per period, capturing recurring revenue, headcount, runway, cash, margin, and churn.
Fair-value marks per portfolio company per close cycle, the investor-side valuation of each holding.
Investee companies held by one or more funds, with headline financials, board composition, ownership percentage, exit status, and sector tagging.
Large bodies of work in the portfolio backlog that are funded, analyzed, and delivered through a funnel before decomposing into features.
Ship-store retail sales of non-fuel goods, paid at the register or posted to a customer house account.
Projected need for specific roles derived from the capacity model: which positions, when, where, and at what level, feeding the requisition pipeline.
FCRA-mandated notices sent to a candidate before a final adverse-action decision, including the report and rights summary and opening a dispute waiting period.
Pre-employment records covering the window between offer acceptance and start date, tracking paperwork, background checks, and pre-boarding tasks.
Outputs of machine-learning and statistical models such as flight-risk and mobility scores, with model identifier, training window, and per-employee scores.
Proactive forecasts emitted before symptoms surface, such as predicted capacity exhaustion, component failure, or an upcoming service-level breach.
Gating rules that control learning-path progression, requiring completions, scores, certifications, or competencies before the next step.
Per-vehicle-class preventive maintenance schedule templates, defining trigger basis, task list, and due-date generation rules.
Pricing rules for the quoting engine, covering tiered and volume discounts, seat and duration pricing, bundle discounts, and segment overrides.
Activity executions within a process instance such as a service task or gateway, each with its own lifecycle and dispatched job.
Resource-constrained or time-trapped steps found in a process, with severity, estimated throughput impact, and recommended mitigation.
Results of conformance checking that compare an event log against a reference process model, flagging deviations with severity, type, and root cause.
Deployed, executable process models with a unique key and version, from which process instances are started.
Append-only records of individual state changes in the process engine, the immutable execution history used for replay, recovery, and mining.
Blocked process executions such as exhausted retries or unhandled errors that halt an activity until an operator resolves them, with failure detail.
Running or completed executions of a process definition, holding token position, variables, and correlation key as the durable unit the engine advances.
Executions of a process simulation scenario against a process model, with input variables, outputs such as throughput and bottlenecks, and run metadata.
